summary: TopBuild Corp filed an 8-K disclosing that it entered into a merger agreement with QXO, Inc. Under the agreement, QXO’s subsidiary Titanium MergerCo will merge into TopBuild, making TopBuild a wholly owned QXO subsidiary; then TopBuild will merge into another QXO sub. The filing does not state price per share or premium. Both companies’ stockholders will vote on the merger at special meetings on June 29, 2026. A stockholder lawsuit in Delaware Chancery Court alleges fiduciary duty breaches over disclosure adequacy. The transaction requires regulatory approvals; watch for litigation resolution and stockholder vote outcome.
